work_items.name: 48×48 adult cast, original art and cached layer engine
work_items.description:
New designs use eight authored adult fantasy/cyborg 48×48 silhouettes with restricted garment colors, local remix and a bounded undo history. Faces, skin, hair and mechanical parts stay authored. Native caches render the same sixteen portable RGBA fixtures with exact physical pixels. Twelve 16×16 creatures remain independent. This is a finite curated library, with more reviewed designs still needed. Legacy layered recipes and original controls remain readable; their blink tests are compatibility coverage. The asset builder removes stray atlas divider lines before palette reduction. Original source art, prompts, actual runtime sheets and provenance are versioned.

work_items.description:

Optional AI persona refinement has a 35-second model timeout and 1,800-token budget; the preceding capability query has a separate 12-second bound. Connector requests still require separate account authorization. All five bot-build skill copies match. Saved v2 recipes without modern look metadata remain compatible.

work_items.name: Cast/companion selection
work_items.description:
Beta.5 ships a shared native Pixel studio/review editor with nine appearance traits, pinned local remixes, restore-to-cast and twelve independent 16×16 familiars. Changing a companion preserves the authored 48×48 portrait. Skin/hair color overrides are independent; older six-field recipes still decode. Pins survive closing/reopening and lazy-list disposal. Save controls freeze while the metadata request is pending. Cosmetic edits preserve the briefing and access, with the existing host metadata revision check.
Native pin/remix/companion interaction tests pass on both platforms. Shared UTF-8 seed/RGBA fixtures verify identical native recipes and pixels. Demo captures: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/docs/evidence/pixel-atelier-editor.png . Further saved-look history and custom art polish are tracked under NIO-36. Release: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.5

work_items.description:

Ten ARM64 emulator checks pass, including Linux/Node/DSH, private authenticated HTTP/WebSocket access, Start/Stop, workspace preservation, a native preset/model-stream/history round trip, portable rendering and workshop UI. work_items.name: Accessibility, tablet layouts and performance
work_items.description:
The UI uses flat stepped pixel frames consistently for cards, lists, controls and tab accents, shorter dashboard text and four focused workshop tabs. The create action remains visible; controls use at least 44pt targets where changed. Android name editing no longer inherits Material text-field padding. Modern static previews use bounded caches and no blink loop; idle Android indicators no longer animate indefinitely. Local checks pass: 39 iOS unit plus five demo UI tests, 30 Android unit plus ten ARM64 emulator checks, fourteen Python checks, 31 Node checks and 38 standalone Swift assertions. The UI suites cover immediate preview, selected portrait, remix/undo, tab persistence and creature selection. Native demo captures were visually inspected. Broader Dynamic Type/tablet/physical and battery acceptance remain open.

work_items.name: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
work_items.description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.
